The brief

Sport & corporate events

Live scoring courtside, on an interactive touchscreen

For a corporate charity padel tournament, we built a custom registration and team management platform with tailored attendee emails, plus a live tournament system on interactive touchscreens — real-time fixtures, scoring and results for players and spectators throughout the day.

Culture & entertainment

Global Canvas Initiative — an immersive World Cup experience

Timed around FIFA World Cup 2026 matches at MetLife Stadium, Global Canvas is a 40-day gamified art and culture experience across six installations at American Dream Mall, New Jersey. We built the immersive web app behind it — scan a QR code at any installation to collect points, unlock rewards and vote live as artists compete.

Corporate events

8,000 attendees, one seamless check-in

For a major corporate event in New York, we ran attendance scanning across multiple locations alongside a custom event web app, team activity sign-ups and QR codes throughout — all backed by live reporting that kept activity data and event information in one place.

Attendance management Event companion app
Media & brand activation

A giant touchscreen quiz that turned footfall into data

For a leading UK news publisher's in-office activation, we built an interactive news quiz on a giant touchscreen at the heart of a modular pop-up stand. Visitors played at the stand with our staff on hand, or scanned a QR code to play on their own device and returned to claim a sustainable gift. Every play captured attendee data that fed straight into follow-up subscription emails and a post-event survey.

Touchscreen rental & software development Custom solutions & consultancy
Media & retail activation

An interactive shop window that shows how people decide what to buy

For a leading UK news brand, we turned a pop-up shop window into a hands-on brand experience. Visitors browsed products on display, then took a quiz on a giant touchscreen, or on their own phone via QR code, to enter a prize draw.

Each question drew on one of six audience groups, from Gen Z to business owners. Along the way, players learned how the brand reaches these audiences and how much it influences their purchase decisions. Every entry was captured as data for follow-up.

Finance & gala events

1,500 guests through the door in 30 minutes

For a finance society's gala at a landmark New York venue, our high-speed badging kiosks printed accreditation for 1,500 guests who all arrived within a 30-minute window. Each guest arrived with a pass in their phone wallet that directed them to the right lane for their category, VIP or general admission. They scanned, collected their printed badge and walked straight in.
